info.name: CommitteeFlow API
info.description:
Every CommitteeFlow endpoint, ordered so the collection runs end to end under newman.

The run signs in as a Project Engineer, walks the whole booking lifecycle (create → read → history → update → conflict → cancel), checks the shared-committee-session rule, exercises Plan Configuration as a plan manager, verifies that a Viewer is refused every write, and downloads both exports.

Authentication is a session cookie; newman keeps the jar between requests. The CSRF token is read from the readable mirror cookie in a pre-request script, exactly as the SPA does.
